lines.text: Jacob reaches a field with a well under a large stone, and the shepherds there say they are from Haran.
When Rachel arrives with her father's sheep, Jacob rolls the stone away, waters the sheep, kisses her, and weeps aloud.
Rachel runs and tells her father, and Laban runs out, embraces Jacob, and calls him his own flesh and blood.
Jacob offers to serve ten years for Rachel, and the years seem to him like only a few days.
In the evening Laban gives Jacob his daughter Leah, and gives his servant girl Hagar to Leah as her maidservant.
